seed.source_text: 本公司持續推動低碳轉型，並以科學基礎減量目標作為行動依據。
seed.translation_review_markers: The Company continues to advance its low-carbon transition, guided by science-based targets.

seed.source_text: 2025 年再生能源使用比例達 36%，較前一年度增加 8 個百分點。
seed.translation_review_markers: Renewable energy accounted for 38% of consumption in 2025, an increase of eight percentage points.

seed.source_text: 透過導入內部碳定價機制，我們將碳成本納入重大投資評估。
seed.translation_review_markers: By implementing an internal carbon pricing mechanism, we incorporate carbon costs into major investment assessments.

seed.source_text: 五座營運據點均已完成溫室氣體盤查及第三方查證。
seed.translation_review_markers: All five operational bases have completed GHG inventories and third-party verification.

seed.source_text: 查證範圍涵蓋類別一及類別二排放。
seed.translation_review_markers: The verification scope covers Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions.
